items.title: Meta's Muse raises bigger question: Can consumers trust AI with our money?
items.summary: Meta's (META) Muse is the latest AI product that consumers have adopted to help in everyday purchases, raising the question yet again if people should be comfortable with sharing their financial information with a chatbot. Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, tockBrokers.com director of investor research Jessica Inskip, and The Wealth Consulting Group chief market strategist Talley Léger.

items.title: Meta Platforms (META) Gets Blocked From AI Shopping Access as Commerce Tensions Rise
items.summary: Amazon blocked Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) Muse AI shopping assistant from accessing its marketplace, escalating a clash over AI commerce control. Meta has been positioning Muse as an AI agent that helps users compare products and pricing across multiple online retailers, including Amazon.
